items.name: Smile Mart (Supermarket)

items.about: A 24-hour supermarket in Sairee (Hin Wong Bay Road) stocking a wide range of Western and Asian groceries, plus dairy, bread, toiletries and homewares. It has a dedicated alcohol aisle but no fresh produce
items.recommendation: Choose Smile Mart (Supermarket) when you need being the only full-service Sairee supermarket (open 24/7) with convenience items on Koh Tao.
items.localTip: Always open, but aisles can be narrow. Take a flashlight at night – aisles not all well-lit. Prices are fixed (no haggling). Bring your own bag (plastic bags are sold at checkout)
perfectFor: being the only full-service Sairee supermarket (open 24/7) with convenience items
items.payment: Cash, Thai bank ATM, credit cards at register
items.localFact: Popular late-night stock-up for alcohol

items.name: ChaiWat Supermarket (Supermarket)
items.cardDescription: A traditional Thai-style general store in Mae Haad (near the post office). It is packed floor-to-ceiling (“Aladdin’s cave”) with homewares, furniture, stationery, plus a huge range of toiletries, foodstuffs, tobacco...
items.about: A traditional Thai-style general store in Mae Haad (near the post office). It is packed floor-to-ceiling (“Aladdin’s cave”) with homewares, furniture, stationery, plus a huge range of toiletries, foodstuffs, tobacco and booze
items.recommendation: Choose ChaiWat Supermarket (Supermarket) when you need being a one-stop Thai bazaar – find almost anything here on Koh Tao.
items.localTip: Most items are fixed-price; bargaining not expected. Visit early to avoid crowds. Photography allowed (some shopkeepers mind, so ask first)
perfectFor: being a one-stop Thai bazaar – find almost anything here

items.about: A traditional Thai wet market in Mae Haad (near the village center). Opens very early (around 5–6 am) and closes by late afternoon. **Short description:** Several open-air stalls sell the day’s catch, fresh cuts of pork/chicken, and a variety of local fruits and vegetables
items.recommendation: Choose Mae Haad Fresh Market when you need bargain-priced tropical produce and seafood on Koh Tao.
items.localTip: Best before 10 am for largest selection. Carry small change (no change from large notes). Feel free to ask prices before picking goods. Bring your own bag or basket
